_about: Narrator lines for the featured games other than Werewolf (see script.json). Top level is the game; inside, each key is a moment and each entry is one variant, saved as audio/<game>/<id>.mp3. Names and anything players type are never spoken; those stay on screen.

lobby: Welcome to Party Night! Grab your phone, scan the code, and pull up a seat.
Evening, everyone. The village is open. Join on your phone and we'll get started.
pick-game: Whenever you're ready, pick a game. I'll wait. I'm very patient.
times-up: Time's up! Pencils down. Thumbs down. Everything down.
everyone-in: That's everyone. Let's see what you've done.
paused: Paused. Go get a snack. I'll keep your seat warm.
game-over: And that's the game! Take a bow, all of you.
What a round. Some of you should be proud. You know who you are.
next-up: Don't get too comfortable. The next game is ready.
goodnight: That's the end of game night. Thank you for visiting the village. Come back soon.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Imposter. Everyone gets the same secret word. Everyone except one of you. Check your phone, and keep a straight face.
intro-2
One of you is about to pretend very, very hard. Look at your phone for the secret word.
clues: Time for clues. One word each. Helpful enough to prove you know the word, vague enough that the imposter learns nothing.
clues-fast: Everyone, type one clue. They'll all appear together.
lap2: Once more around. Imposter, I hope you were listening.
discuss: Now talk it over. Whose clue was a little too vague? Who's sweating?
vote: Time to vote. Point your finger, politely, on your phone.
caught: Caught! But wait. The imposter gets one guess at the secret word. Get it right, and they steal the win.
escaped: Oh dear. That was not the imposter. The real one has been smiling this whole time.
stole: They guessed it! Caught red-handed, and they still win. Outrageous.
crew-wins: Wrong word! The crew wins. Well spotted, everyone.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Ducky Toss. Toss two rubber ducks, score points for how they land, and decide: bank it, or toss again? Get greedy, and you could lose it all.
intro-2
Two ducks. One question. How lucky do you feel?
your-turn: Fresh ducks. Give them a toss.
big-roll: Ooh! That's a rare one. Big points!
bust: Splash! Both ducks belly-up. That turn's points are gone.
And that is why they say: bank it.
close: We have a leader closing in on the finish. Everyone else, time to take some risks.
win: win-1
We have a Ducky Toss champion! The ducks salute you.

intro: intro-1
Hot Potato! I'll give you a category. Say an answer out loud, then toss the potato on your phone. Whoever's holding it when it blows gets burned.
intro-2
This potato is hot, and it is ticking. Say an answer, pass it on, and hope.
boom: Kaboom. That's going to leave a mark.
win: win-1
The coolest hands in the village! Well played.

intro: intro-1
It's Bingo time! Your card is on your phone. Tap the squares as I call them, and when you've got it, hit that Bingo button.
intro-2
Eyes down, everyone. Let's play Bingo.
pattern-line: We're playing for one line. Any row, any column, or corner to corner.
pattern-corners: This game is four corners. Just the corners.
pattern-blackout: This one's a blackout. Every single square. Settle in.
false: Not quite! Check your card. We keep going.
Ooh, a false alarm. Nice try.
bingo: That's a Bingo! Somebody's been paying attention.

intro: intro-1
Quick Games! Fast questions, big opinions. There are no wrong answers. Only answers we'll judge you for.
intro-2
Let's find out what this room really thinks.
hot: Hot take! Pick your side, then guess what most of the room picked.
wyr: Would you rather? Choose quickly. Overthinking is cheating.
mlt: Most likely to! Vote for the person in this room who fits best. Be honest. They can take it.
reveal-split: Look at that. Split right down the middle. Feel free to argue.
win: win-1
That's Quick Games. You've all learned something about each other. Sorry about that.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Sketch Telephone. Write something weird. The next person will have to draw it.
intro-2
It starts with a few innocent words. It will not end that way.
draw: Now draw what you were given. No letters. No numbers. Just art.
Time to draw. Remember: confidence matters more than talent.
guess: What on earth is that drawing? Describe it in a few words.
Look at the masterpiece on your phone. What is it?
reveal: Time for the big reveal. Let's see how it all fell apart.
chain-start: Here's the next one. It began so simply.
chain-end: And that's where it ended up. Remarkable.
hearts: Tap the heart on your phone for the ones you love.
win: win-1
And the most loved artist of the evening is on your screen. Frame that.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Salad Bowl. Everyone, secretly add three names to the bowl. Famous people, characters, anyone this group would know.
intro-2
First, we fill the bowl. Three names each. Keep them secret.
round1: Round one: describe it. Say anything you like, except the name itself.
round2: Round two: one word. Same names, but you get exactly one word per name. Choose wisely.
round3: Round three: act it out. Same names again. No talking. Not a sound.
ready: Clue-giver, press start when your team is ready.
empty: The bowl is empty! Don't worry, the names are going back in.
win: win-1
And the winning team takes the Salad Bowl. A real bowl is not included.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Funny Answers. You'll each get a couple of prompts. Write the funniest answer you can. Then the room decides who did it better.
intro-2
Time to be funny on purpose. Check your phone for your prompts.
vote: Two answers enter. Vote for your favorite.
Which one is funnier? Vote now.
sweep: A clean sweep! Every single vote.
Unanimous! That one's going on the fridge.
tie: A tie! You're both equally funny. Or equally not.
round2: Round two. The points are doubled, so try twice as hard.
final: Final round. Everyone answers the same prompt, and everyone votes. Triple points.
win: win-1
We have a winner. Officially the funniest person in the room. Don't let it go to your head.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Mind Meld. One of you sees a secret spot between two opposites, and gives a clue. Everyone else slides their dial to where they think it is.
intro-2
Let's find out how well you can read each other's minds.
clue: Mind reader, check your phone. Give a clue that sits right on that secret spot.
guess: There's your clue. Talk it over, then set your dials.
reveal: Let's see where it really was.
meld: Mind meld! You're all thinking as one. Slightly worrying.
miss: Oh. Oh no. Not even close. We'll say no more about it.
win: win-1
And our best mind reader is revealed. Everyone else, guard your thoughts.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Doodle Bluff. Each of you has a secret title. Draw it as well as you can. Nobody else knows what it is.
intro-2
Artists, to your phones. Draw your secret title. No words allowed.
fake: Behold. What is this drawing called? Write a fake title that sounds like the real thing.
Here's our next masterpiece. Invent a title for it.
pick: One of these titles is real. The rest are lies. Which is which?
fooled-all: That fake fooled almost everyone. Magnificent lying.
win: win-1
And that's Doodle Bluff. Some fine art, and some very fine lies.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Who Said That. First, answer a few questions about yourself. Be honest. Then we'll see who really knows who.
intro-2
Let's find out how well you know each other. Start by answering on your phone.
guess: Here's an answer. Who said it?
Somebody in this room wrote this. But who?
nobody: Nobody got that one! We have a mystery person among us.
everybody: Everyone got it. Some people are an open book.
win: win-1
And the person who knows this group best is on your screen. A little too well, perhaps.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Clue Crew. You're all on one team. One of you guesses the secret word. Everyone else writes a one-word clue. But be careful: matching clues cancel each other out.
intro-2
Tonight you win together or lose together. Guesser, no peeking at phones.
clue: Write your clue. One word. Try to think of something nobody else will.
cancel: Uh oh. Some of you had the same idea. Those clues are gone.
all-cancel: Every clue cancelled! Guesser, you're on your own. Good luck.
guess: Guesser, here's what survived. What's the word?
wrong: Not the word. And that costs you an extra card.
pass: A pass. Sometimes that's the wise move.
end-great: What a crew! You practically share a brain.
end-low: Well. You tried. Maybe sit closer together next time.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Picture Charades. The actor's phone shows a picture. Act it out. No talking, no sounds. Everyone else, shout your guesses!
intro-2
It's charades! Actors, your picture is on your phone. Not a word.
ready: Our next actor is up. Press start when you're ready.
A new performer takes the stage.
win: win-1
And the award for best performance goes to the name on your screen. Bravo!

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Color Clash. Match the color or the symbol on the top card. First to play every card wins.
intro-2
Cards are dealt. Match the color or the symbol, and be the first to empty your hand.
wild4: Four cards. There go your plans.
last-card: One card left! Somebody stop them!
win: win-1
Out of cards! We have a Color Clash winner.

intro: intro-1
Color Hunt! When I say go, run and touch what I ask for. Then tap your phone. Ready?
intro-2
Hunters, get ready! Leave your phones on the couch, find it, then run back and tap.
red: Find something red! Go go go!
blue: Find something blue! Go go go!
green: Find something green! Go go go!
yellow: Find something yellow! Go go go!
orange: Find something orange! Go go go!
purple: Find something purple! Go go go!
white: Find something white! Go go go!
black: Find something black! Go go go!
pink: Find something pink! Go go go!
brown: Find something brown! Go go go!
round: Find something round, like a ball! Go!
soft: Find something soft, like a pillow! Go!
star: Find something with a star on it! Go!
square: Find something square, like a box! Go!
chair: Touch your nose, then find a chair! Go!
first: We have our first hunter back! Super fast!
win: win-1
The hunt is over! You were all amazing. Now put everything back.

intro: intro-1
Freeze Dance! Dance while the music plays. When it stops, freeze like a statue and tap your phone. But don't tap too early!
intro-2
Time to dance! When the music stops, you stop. Ready?
early: Oops! Somebody tapped too early. Wait for the music to stop.
win: win-1
What dancers! Our freeze champion is on the screen. Everybody take a bow.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Copy Cat. Watch the lights and listen. Then copy the pattern on your phone. It gets longer every round.
intro-2
Watch closely. I'm going to show you a pattern, and you're going to copy it.
all-right: Everybody got it! Let's make it harder.
lost-heart: Oops, that cost a heart. Keep going!
long: Eight in a row! This is getting serious.
win: win-1
What a memory! Our Copy Cat champion is on the screen.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Midnight Wolves. One night. One vote. Look at your card, and tell no one. Three more cards lie face down in the middle of the village.
intro-2
Tonight will be short, and strange. Check your card. Remember it. It may not stay yours.
night: Night falls. Everyone, look at your phone. If you have a power, use it now. If you don't, tap anyway, so nobody can tell.
morning: The sun rises. Read what you learned in the night. And remember: your card may have changed while you slept.
day: Now talk. Who are you? Who were you? Somebody here is a wolf, and they will lie about it.
vote: One vote. Make it count. Who is the wolf?
win-village: A wolf has been caught! The village wins.
The village chose well. The wolf is found.
win-wolves: The wolves walk free. The village chose wrong.
No wolf was caught. Sleep well. If you can.
no-wolves: There were no wolves at all. And you trusted each other. How lovely. The village wins.

intro: intro-1
Welcome to Taboo Talk. Describe the word on your phone so your team can guess it. But don't say the forbidden words. The other team is watching.
intro-2
Two teams. One rule: don't say the words in red.
ready: Clue-giver, press start when your team is ready. Other team, fingers on your buzzers.
buzz: Buzzed! That was a forbidden word.
win: win-1
And that's the game. The winning team may now say whatever words they like.
tie: It's a tie! Nobody wins. Or everybody does. Your choice.
